Daily Devotional

March 9

3 Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. (2 John 1:3 KJV)

Grace, mercy and peace don’t just automatically come to you. They are evident and in proportion to the amount of knowledge that we have of the Word of God (2 Peter 1:2-4). In order to obtain these qualities, you must study the Word of God, renewing your mind (Romans 12:2), and put them in your heart, so that you will have the peace of God living in you.

All born again believers have been given the fruit of the spirit (Galatians 5:22-23), which is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, faith, meekness and temperance. But to enjoy the benefit of these things, we must study the Word and put it in our hearts, so that we realize just what we do have in our new born again spirit (Philemon 1:6). There really is no way to walk in the benefit of being a Christian without a total commitment to studying the Word of God. After all, the Word of God is His communication with us, His children. It is God’s instruction manual for us to live by, so study it, and become a disciple indeed of Jesus (John 8:31). We must obey Jesus to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Thank you Lord for giving us the bible.
